mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS bookId, b.name AS bookName, b.author AS author, b.isbn AS isbn, b.available_num AS availableNum, b.total_num AS totalNum FROM book b WHERE b.status = 1 AND (b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR b.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR b.isbn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%')) ORDER BY b.available_num DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id AS borrowId, b.name AS bookName, b.author AS author, r.borrow_time AS borrowTime, r.due_time AS dueTime, r.renew_count AS renewCount, CASE WHEN r.due_time < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue FROM borrow_record r JOIN book b ON b.id = r.book_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.due_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
